rows.title: Freedom (Theme From Panther) [Diamond D's Crystal Mix]
notes: “and then right after that then it breaks into freedom letting me run in my own”
1995 Mercury 12" single, theme from the film Panther — a Diamond D remix of Joi's 1994 track 'Freedom', written by Joi Gilliam/Dallas Austin/Diamond D.

rows.title: The Pendulum Vibe
notes: “you've been listening to a hip-hop, contemporary R&B, soul and funk episode. You've been listening to Joy and their debut album, The Pendulum Vibe”
Joi's 1994 debut album on EMI, produced by Dallas Austin, includes her original version of 'Freedom' — a neo-soul/funk cult classic.
